title: Trauma-Informed and Culturally Safe Practice
description: This module supports practitioners to apply trauma-informed, culturally safe, and person-centred approaches in DFV work. It focuses on safety, trust, empowerment, and respect for cultural identity and lived experience.
outcomes: Apply trauma-informed principles in DFV practice
Work in culturally safe and respectful ways
Promote empowerment, choice, and safety for clients
